evidence.quote: The primary mission of ZYZZsat is to image the whole Great Barrier Reef in visible bands at 5 m resolution
The operator is the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS)... The customers are the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority
One satellite is therefore used. This also simplifies communications, reduces cost

criteria.reasoning: All required information addressed in detail: primary mission, rationale with cited literature, single-spacecraft justification, operator and customers. Well referenced; only minor depth lacking on user needs analysis.

evidence.quote: The baseline is an SSMS rideshare flight on Vega C from Kourou in early 2025
cos i = −0.1355, so i = 97.79°. This agrees with the STK value of 97.7924°
There are six passes each day... the mean pass lasts 580.8 s, or 9.7 minutes
With a 4 m² sail the satellite re-enters about two years after the end of the mission

criteria.reasoning: Comprehensive, accurate design: launch site/vehicle with justified trade, hand calculations (azimuth, J2 sun-sync inclination, decay) verified correct, STK screenshots, access tables, data budget, EOL plan. Link budget admittedly missing, a minor gap.

evidence.quote: A 600 km sun-synchronous orbit at 97.79° inclination gives the same morning lighting on every pass

criteria.reasoning: Conclusions follow directly from the evidence and include honest limitations and next-phase actions; slightly more quantitative summary would make it fully accomplished.

evidence.quote: This report presents the design of ZYZZsat... a single Earth observation microsatellite for monitoring coral bleaching
Figure 2: Inclination required for a sun-synchronous orbit as a function of altitude.

criteria.reasoning: Clear structure, concise executive summary, numbered/labelled figures and tables, consistent formatting, in-text citations [1]–[15] matching bibliography. Minor: some references (e.g. [4], [15]) are loosely specified.

technical_issues.issue: X-band link budget not performed (acknowledged by student); 50 Mbit/s assumed feasible.
Vega C unflown at time of writing; fallback acknowledged but adds risk.
Decay estimate uses single mean density; student correctly notes solar-cycle factor-of-ten uncertainty.

overall: Excellent, technically sound mission design report. All task requirements addressed with verified hand calculations, STK evidence and files, clear structure and referencing. Minor gaps: link budget and some loosely specified references.
